title: Jewelry
sub: Six jewelry brands with real markdowns of up to 75% on pieces worth wearing.

brands.say: The 18K gold plated Alice necklace was $198, now $68. Pavé Gracie hoops were $98, now $35. The Cece cuff is half off at $77.
brands.why_not: These are sale-section markdowns; homepage also advertises 30% off sitewide, not confirmed to stack. Alice necklace carries a final-sale tag.

items.name: Alice Pearl Necklace
items.note: 66% off, pavé tennis-style chain with pearl drops; on-model shot looks expensive

items.name: Gracie Pavé Hoops
items.note: 64% off, chunky pavé teardrop hoop, on-trend shape

items.name: Cece Twist Cuff
items.note: 51% off, sculptural gold cuff, clean product shot

brands.say: Now & Then pearl drop hoops were $78, now $26. The Layers of You bangle stack was $74, now $26. Moment necklace $88 down to $29.
brands.why_not: First photo of every item is a text card, so use img 1 (on-model). Homepage headline offer is BOGO free sitewide; catalog markdowns are separate. Pieces are dainty.

brands.say: The Amélia CZ tennis necklace was $318, now $159. Robyn ribbed sterling silver ring $224 down to $94. Paperclip chain bracelet half off at $121.
brands.why_not: Higher price points than the other brands. Necklace and bracelet are tagged final sale. Homepage headline is only 20% off sitewide.

brands.say: The Bean Gold earrings were $100, now $40. Gigi pearl earrings $90 down to $36. Isla shell necklace $100, now $40. All final sale.
brands.why_not: All items are final sale. Isla necklace has only the cream colour left (1 of 2). Gaze Choker excluded: only 20% off.

brands.say: The Gia cuff was $150, now $40. Amour heart earrings $116 down to $58. Estelle chain necklace $154, now $94.
brands.why_not: Small sale section (56 items). Estelle necklace is 39% off, the smallest discount in the edit. Homepage BFCM offer is 20-25% off, separate from these markdowns.

brands.say: Elena crystal statement earrings were $198, now $49. Manon crystal slider necklace $198 down to $79. Islaine gemstone necklace half off at $114.
brands.why_not: Maximalist, occasion-style jewelry, less everyday than the other brands. These three are tagged final sale and are single-variant.
